name: Upholstered headboard: KLEPPSTAD with VIHALS nightstands, dresser on the window end, BESTÅ column by the closet
notes:
Alternative, re-checked 2026-10-23: the upholstered-headboard look, KLEPPSTAD with VIHALS nightstands, plus the BESTÅ column by the closet (F-63). The floor lamp and hamper moved up the left wall, from 1" to 15" clear of the door's swing. 12 placed, 11 extras.
bed-1 KLEPPSTAD queen, white frame and Vissle beige headboard (washable cover) (floor): right wall, headboard centered, rot 90, x 95.1-177, y 34.75-97. F-34: 31.75" on the window side to the heater's face, 36" on the bathroom side, the edge of the bathroom door's 36" landing (F-31); F-33: bedding 31.75" from the heater face.
nightstand-1 VIHALS white (floor): window side of the head, x 162.375-177, y 20.125-34.75. F-33: 17.125" from the heater face. The same white VIHALS line as the dining set. shelf-1 LACK wall shelf, white, 11 3/4x10 1/4" (top): the bathroom side's nightstand, hung at mattress height, x 166.75-177, y 97-108.75, so the floor in front of the bathroom door (eyeballed at x 139-169) stays clear for the full 36" (F-31, assumed-position:door). 6.5 lb max and anchored (IKEA): the lamp, a phone and a book.
lamp-1, lamp-2 VARPTROSS bamboo wall lamps (top): on the head wall, one over the nightstand and one over the shelf, about 24" above the mattress, their cords in covers along the head wall to an outlet (where the outlets are is still open); they replace the 12" STORSEGEL table lamps, too low to read by (final audit 2026-10-26). art-1 PJÄTTERYD endless tide (top): over the 33.9" textile headboard, centered.
rug-1 TIOKRONA (rug): rot 0, x 40-158, y 18.875-112.875: under the lower 63" of the bed and the bench, 4.4" short of the nightstand (it stopped 3/8" from it until the final audit 2026-10-26); 15.875" off the heater face (F-33).
dresser-1 STORKLINTA 6-drawer (floor): left wall's window end, x 0-18.9, y 12-67.1. F-33: 9" from the heater face; F-32: 63.25" from its drawer fronts to the bench; anchor-required (F-21). plant-1 FEJKA (top): on its window end.
bench-1 PERJOHAN pine (floor): across the foot of the bed, 2" off it, x 82.1-93.1, y 46.2-85.6. F-30: 63.25" to the dresser, 47.4" to the bottom wall.
floor-lamp-1 TÅGARP (floor): left wall, x 0-9, y 69-78, beside the dresser's lower end. hamper-1 PURRPINGLA (floor): left wall, x 0-17.3, y 80-88. F-31: 15" clear of the door's swing (assumed-position:door).
Walkways (F-30): door to bathroom along the bottom of the room, 36" beside the bed and open floor before it (the BESTÅ column came off the bottom wall at the final audit 2026-10-26: the walk had to turn its corner 19.5" from the bed's foot); the 36" landings in front of the closet and the bathroom door stay clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:door).
Window wall: nothing but the curtains. F-33 allows furniture 6" off the heater, but a cabinet there would box in the heater along the whole hatched wall, so no BESTÅ goes on it.
Extras: STOPP FILT underlays x2 under the rug, VALEVÅG mattress x1, DVALA queen sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE Full/Queen insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA natural cover set x1, VILDKORN pillows x2, FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window).
Not placed: the BESTÅ column ikea-39429699 (on the bottom wall the walk to the bathroom had to turn its corner 19.5" from the bed's foot, F-30, final audit 2026-10-26; the walk-in closet and the dresser hold the linens, and f keeps it on the left wall); the NISSEDAL mirror ikea-30503778 (glass with no safety film on its page, F-21; a dressing mirror with one goes inside the walk-in closet); the STORSEGEL table lamps ikea-60573576 (12" tall, too low to read by; the wall lamps replace them); the STORKLINTA and HEMNES 2-drawer nightstands ikea-90559296 and ikea-80242627 (18 7/8" and 15" deep, they stood in front of the bathroom doorway; design review 2026-10-23), a second VIHALS nightstand (any floor nightstand on the bathroom side stands in the bathroom door's 36" landing, F-31) and the BRIMNES wardrobe ikea-90574800. Same headboard reasoning as a.
Total $1,598.77: placed $909.89 + extras $688.88; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, anchor-required (dresser-1).
Design review 2026-10-23: the deeper nightstands covered the right 7 to 10.9" of the bathroom doorway with 14 to 15.4" in front, and the slim VIHALS pair that replaced them still covered its last 6.6" at 20.75" out. With F-31's 36" landing in front of every door, the bathroom side takes the LACK floating shelf and the bed group moves up 5/8", so the bed's side is 36" from the bottom wall.
2026-10-25: the heater is 3" deep (Andrew), not the 6" drawn when this layout was made, and the clearances to its face above are restated to the 3" (final audit 2026-10-26); the bathroom door's landing is now 30" (Andrew: "ok"), and this layout keeps 36" clear in front of it.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the BESTÅ column came off the bottom wall, where the walk to the bathroom had to turn its corner 19.5" from the bed's foot (F-30; 36" beside the bed was measured along the wall, not through the turn); the glass NISSEDAL came off the plan (F-21: no safety film on its page); the STORSEGEL table lamps became VARPTROSS wall lamps over the nightstand and the shelf; the TIOKRONA got its two STOPP FILT underlays, as its page asks; the rug moved 4" left, clear of the nightstand.
